dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped structures exhibit thin, high-intensity white perimeters with sharp gradient transitions to dark interior pixels; edges appear irregular and non-uniform in thickness across the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated cluster of small, high-intensity white pixel aggregates localized on the facial region; sparse distribution of isolated solid white blobs interspersed between larger ring structures on the mid-section and posterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Primary scalene triangle formed by the centroids of three distinct macro-annuli on the upper mid-dorsal surface; a linear chain of four interconnected ring structures visible along the lower lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct micro-speckled high-contrast pattern localized on the rostrum and ocular regions, featuring significantly smaller pixel-radius than the primary dorsal ring structures.
